subject: SIG v12 revision: change log request & evidence tracker
messages:
From: Emily Stone <emily.stone@finbank.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: FinBank Security Team <security@finbank.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG v12 request — changes and updated answers

Hi Mina,

Hope you’re well. We’re updating our vendor SIG to v12 and need Redwood’s updated answers plus a short diff highlighting questions that changed since the sig_v10 we received last year. Our procurement window is tight — can you provide: 1) a completed SIG spreadsheet with re-answers, 2) a single-page diff summary (what changed and why), and 3) any supporting evidence (SOC2 report, network diagram, KMS/key rotation policy).

If possible, can we get a first pass by end of week? Attached is the v12 question set with the changed sections highlighted.

Thanks,
Emily Stone
Senior InfoSec Manager | FinBank
[Attachment: SIG_v12_questions.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@finbank.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG v12 request — changes and updated answers

Hi Emily — thanks for the heads up and the annotated questions. I’ll lead the response.

Plan:
- Aditya will own re-answering business/process questions and the diff spreadsheet.
- Dev (cc’d on subsequent thread) will provide tech evidence (network diagram, KMS policy, encryption notes).
- Laura will review legal impact on any contractual obligations (if any re: data residency).

Target: first-draft re-answers by Friday (2026-07-31). We’ll attach SOC2 Type II 2025 and a short diff summary. If anything is critical for procurement sooner, flag with a line and we’ll prioritize that Q.

Mina Haddad
Head of Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: (none)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG v12 request — changes and updated answers

Mina — initial draft attached. I walked the spreadsheet and re-answered ~220 questions; marked those with substantive wording changes (column: CHANGE_TYPE).

Notes:
- Q3.7 (Encryption in transit): wording tightened; we expanded answer to specify TLS 1.2+ with automatic push to 1.3 where supported.
- Q7.2 (Key management): changed from "Customer-managed KMS supported" to a more detailed matrix — see separate KMS policy from Dev.
- A few questions removed (deprecated) — flagged as DEPRECATION in the diff.

Attachments: sig_v12_reanswers_draft.xlsx (spreadsheet with color-coded diffs).

Next: Dev — can you add the formal KMS excerpt and confirm rotation frequency? Laura — will review any legal redlines tied to new wording.

— Aditya
Principal Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sig_v12_reanswers_draft.xlsx (XLSX, 240KB)]

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG v12 request — changes and updated answers

Aditya/Mina — attaching the requested technical artifacts. Key points:
- KMS: we support both customer-managed (BYOK) and Redwood-managed keys. Customer keys integrate via KMS connectors; rotation policy: default auto-rotate every 90 days, configurable to shorter windows per contract.
- Encryption in transit: TLS 1.2 minimum; TLS 1.3 preferred; load-balancer terminates TLS at edge, internal components use mTLS.
- Network diagram attached shows isolation zones for dedicated/dedicated-private deployments.

Attachments: network_diagram_v3.pdf, redwood_kms_key_policy.txt

If FinBank needs a signed MOU for custom rotation windows, let me know and we’ll loop Legal.

— Dev Patel
Staff Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: network_diagram_v3.pdf (PDF, 420KB)]
[Attachment: redwood_kms_key_policy.txt (TXT, 6KB)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@finbank.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: SIG v12 — final re-answers and diff summary (FINBANK request)

Emily — attaching our final deliverables per your request. Summary below.

Deliverables attached:
- sig_v12_final_reanswers.xlsx — completed SIG v12 with updated answers and inline notes.
- sig_v12_diff_summary.txt — one-page plain-text summary of changes since v10 (what changed, rationale).
- soc2_type2_report_2025.pdf — attestation for controls referenced.
- network_diagram_v3.pdf, redwood_kms_key_policy.txt (technical evidence).

High-level summary of substantive changes:
- Encryption: clarified TLS baseline and internal mTLS usage; updated language to reflect TLS 1.3 push and cipher suites.
- Key management: documented BYOK and rotation policy (default 90 days); added procedure excerpt.
- Data residency: no change to default hosting regions; we added a note on Dedicated/private deployment options.
- Deprecated Qs: 4 questions removed (internal labeling only).

Open items for your confirmation:
1) Key rotation frequency — we default to 90 days, configurable. If FinBank requires 30/45-day rotation in contract, we can evaluate operational impact.
2) Any requested evidence redlines (e.g., additional signed attestations).

Please confirm receipt and whether you want the final XLSX translated to FinBank’s spreadsheet template (we can do that within 24 hours).

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
[Attachments: sig_v12_final_reanswers.xlsx (XLSX, 260KB); sig_v12_diff_summary.txt (TXT, 3KB); soc2_type2_report_2025.pdf (PDF, 2.9MB); network_diagram_v3.pdf; redwood_kms_key_policy.txt]

From: Emily Stone <emily.stone@finbank.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: FinBank Security Team <security@finbank.com>
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG v12 — final re-answers and diff summary (FINBANK request)

Mina — received, thank you. I’ll circulate to procurement and our security reviewers. Quick follow-up: can you confirm the KMS rotation enforcement (technical vs administrative) — i.e., is 90-day rotation enforced automatically by the KMS or is it an administrative process we must attest to? If it’s automatic, we’re good; if not, procurement will ask for a compensating control.

I’ll get back to you by EOD Monday with any redlines.

Best,
Emily
Senior InfoSec Manager | FinBank
[Attachment: (none)]
body_preview: FinBank requested SIG v12 re-answers and diff; Mina assigned tasks; Aditya drafted answers; Dev provided KMS/network evidence; Mina submitted final XLSX + diff + SOC2; FinBank asks clarifying question on key rotation enforcement.
